name: amplifier-skill-project-handoff
description: Pick up a project without repeating the briefing or losing its decisions: a portable skill, plain-file contract, optional Amplifier adapters and a static guide.
runtime: No service or package dependency to use the skill. Python >=3.11 for local build/install/check; browser for the static site.
publication: Local source and preview only. No remote configured or publication performed.
evaluation: Optional live evaluation reads provider credentials from the environment; credentials are not required to install or use the skill.
